title: cyclobalanus javensis
intro: Cyclobalanus javensis, commonly known as East Indian rosewood, is a species of tree in the family Lauraceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Cyclobalanus javensis are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system and relieve anxiety, as well as its antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
